name: Plausible signup-goal evaluation
request: Write exactly one concise marketing email in English introducing Plausible Analytics to a small SaaS website owner who wants to understand trial signups. Explain a concrete first step for setting up or reviewing a signup conversion goal and what the dashboard can show about sources or landing pages. Invite the reader to inspect the official goal-conversions guide. Do not presume their current analytics tool, traffic volume, privacy compliance status, or a measured lift.
audience_segment: Small SaaS website owner measuring signup conversion
